events.content:
Migrated every page and API route to the Next.js App Router and removed the `pages` directory entirely.

The new [root layout](/workspace/app/layout.tsx) replaces `_app` and `_document`. Pages Router data functions now use server components, `headers()`, `generateStaticParams()`, and revalidation. Metadata, 404 handling, and error boundaries use App Router files. The API endpoints use typed `route.ts` handlers, and the provider and back button use typed client components.

`npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm run build` pass. Runtime checks passed for page routes, generated and on-demand blog posts, 404s, and the API methods. The existing `package.json` change and untracked `package-lock.json` were left untouched.

item.text:
Migrated every page and API route to the Next.js App Router and removed the `pages` directory entirely.

The new [root layout](/workspace/app/layout.tsx) replaces `_app` and `_document`. Pages Router data functions now use server components, `headers()`, `generateStaticParams()`, and revalidation. Metadata, 404 handling, and error boundaries use App Router files. The API endpoints use typed `route.ts` handlers, and the provider and back button use typed client components.

`npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm run build` pass. Runtime checks passed for page routes, generated and on-demand blog posts, 404s, and the API methods. The existing `package.json` change and untracked `package-lock.json` were left untouched.

  console.log("'`${options.method ?? '"'GET'} "'${path}: ${response.status} ${title ?? body.slice(0, 120)}`)
}
